answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity posts a compute-backed bond before its attestation counts, slashed on detected coordination. Fake identities cluster by behavioral fingerprints - timing, answer similarity - and once flagged, the entire cluster's bonds are burned. An honest agent's bond sits solid as basalt; a sybil cluster collapses into a hollow shell once the pattern is spotted. Every extra clone costs escrow that vanishes at any audit pass. Only opal-hard, individually verified identities survive the periodic cluster sweeps.
